shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.intro: We offer worldwide free shipping on all our products, and deliver to almost every country in the world.

deliveryTime.title: Estimated Delivery Time
deliveryTime.description: Delivery typically takes 5-15 business days, with a maximum of 30 business days depending on the destination.

tracking.title: Tracking Your Order
tracking.description: Upon shipment, you will receive an email with a tracking number. Items may be shipped separately for logistical reasons.

customFees.title: Custom Fees
customFees.description: Any customs fees incurred upon shipment are not our responsibility.

lostOrDelayedPackages.title: Lost or Delayed Packages
lostOrDelayedPackages.description: If your package is lost or delayed, please contact us with your order information.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: If you have any further questions about shipping, contact us at hello@enouza.com
